items.title: Faster Stable Diffusion on AMD Ryzen™ AI with TeaCache
items.summary: In this blog, you will learn how to accelerate Stable Diffusion 3 and 3.5 image generation on AMD Ryzen AI neural processing units (NPUs) with TeaCache, without retraining. Explore how TeaCache reuses intermediate outputs, compare naive and rescaled caching, and learn how to integrate caching into an ONNX-based pipeline. Use the latency and image-quality results to guide your caching settings, then follow the setup steps to try TeaCache on your Ryzen AI machine.
